title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: She's Out of My League
description: An airport security agent must figure out how to make the relationship work when a beautiful, successful woman falls in love with him.

title: Smart People
description: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

title: First Blood
description: Green Beret veteran Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a Pacific Northwest sheriff (Brian Dennehy) and the National Guard.

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: Jersey Girl
description: A young woman (Liv Tyler) changes the life of a single father (Ben Affleck) who used to be a successful New York music publicist.

title: Hugo
description: A resourceful orphaned boy (Asa Butterfield) and a bookish girl (Chloë Grace Moretz) set out on a quest to unlock a secret left to him by the boy's late father (Jude Law).

title: Sahara
description: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: Uncommon Valor
description: A colonel with a sponsor leads five Marine veterans into Laos to find his son and others missing in action.

title: Risky Business
description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: The General's Daughter
description: Two investigators (John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe) find an underworld of sex and cover-ups behind an Army captain's murder.

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
description: An ad exec and a shower-curtain-ring salesman become co-travelers on the way to Thanksgiving in Chicago.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: Serendipity
description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: Hostage
description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

title: Gangs of New York
description: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

title: Revolutionary Road
description: In the 1950s Connecticut, two suburbanites become increasingly dissatisfied with their marriage and society's expectations of conformity.

title: There Will Be Blood
description: Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) becomes a self-made oil tycoon, but he deviates into moral bankruptcy as his material fortune grows.

title: Failure to Launch
description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Scrooge
description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) meets the spirits of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
description: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

title: Smart People
description: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

title: Rock of Ages
description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

title: Hard Rain
description: A thief (Morgan Freeman), a sheriff (Randy Quaid) and the nephew (Christian Slater) of an armored-truck driver seek money bags in a flooding Indiana town.

title: Another 48 Hrs.
description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond. This time it is to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco Bay Area.

title: The Weather Man
description: A Chicago weather forecaster (Nicolas Cage) tries to mend relations with his father (Michael Caine), his ex-wife (Hope Davis) and his two children.

title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
description: Charlie Brown wins a slot in the national spelling bee in the "Peanuts" gang's first big-screen adventure.

title: Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown!
description: A thrilling raft race highlights the Peanuts gang's summer camp fun.

title: Bon Voyage Charlie Brown (And Don't Come Back)
description: Snoopy plays Wimbledon on the way to France with exchange student Chuck and company.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

title: Cold Mountain
description: During the Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier (Jude Law) abandons his duties to make his way home to his sweetheart (Nicole Kidman).

title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States.

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex.

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: No Code of Conduct
description: Two policemen (Mark Dacascos, Charlie Sheen) learn that city leaders and law enforcement support heroin trafficking across the Mexican border.

title: Hard Eight
description: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.
